summary: OdaHesap backend fully functional. 32/32 pytest tests passed against public preview URL. Auth gating, household lifecycle (create/join/leave with 6-digit invite codes), 3-way expense targeting with strict visibility filtering (household/self/roommate), balance math (net + greedy debt simplification), period close+reset with snapshot, and Gemini 3 Flash Vision OCR on a synthesized German receipt all verified end-to-end.

minor.issue: Endpoint returns {ok:true} even for users not in a household — silent no-op is intentional per implementation, but consider 400 for consistency.
No handling for last member leaving (household becomes memberless / orphaned expenses, periods). Consider auto-deleting or transferring ownership.

Self expenses require an active household — correct per implementation, but the error message 'Önce bir eve katılın' is fine. Note: self expenses ARE gated by household membership, which is stricter than PRD implies (self is 'private to payer'). Confirm this is desired.

action_items: Optional: decide behavior when the last member leaves a household (cleanup vs. keep orphan).
Optional: return 400 when POST /households/leave is called by a user with no household (currently silently returns {ok:true}).
Consider validating ExpenseCreate.total >= 0 or matches sum(items.price); currently blindly stored (negative totals accepted).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); FastAPI recommends lifespan context managers.
server.py is 642 lines — still under the 700-line guideline but approaching it; consider splitting into routers/services soon.
gen_invite_code() allows leading zeros (good) but re-tries only 20 times before 500 — acceptable given 10^6 code space with small user base.

simplify_debts() is greedy (not provably minimal transfers). For the 3-member test case it produces 2 transfers which is optimal here; keep in mind larger groups may not be minimum. Documented as 'greedy' so this is intended.
OCR endpoint has no size/format validation on image_base64 (accepts any base64 including malformed strings before hitting Gemini). Consider a max-size cap and MIME sniff to fail fast.
seed_data_creation: Seeded 4 TEST_ users (alice/bob/carol/dave) with fixed session tokens in odahesap_db. Fixture cleans up TEST_ users, their households, periods, and expenses on session teardown. Tests are safely re-runnable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest.ini forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope`; this suite must be run serially (`-n 0`) because it shares state across ordered classes (household created by Alice → joined by Bob/Carol → expenses → balances → periods close → leave). Fixture `seed_users` in conftest deletes+reseeds TEST_ users. OCR test calls real Gemini via emergentintegrations (EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in backend/.env) and synthesizes a German receipt JPEG via Pillow — takes ~4-5s. Command: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_odahesap_backend.py -v -n 0`.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Only tooling note: initial run under default pytest-xdist parallel workers double-seeded users (email unique index conflict) and ran TestBalances before TestExpenses. Resolved by running with `-n 0` (serial), which is the correct mode for this stateful integration suite.
